qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Dominant global spirits leader owning irreplaceable aged Scotch maturation inventory and distilleries across Scotland protected by statutory geographical indication, alongside iconic Lindy mega-brands (Johnnie Walker, Guinness, Don Julio). Proof of moat demonstrated by 5-year median GAAP ROIC of 14-16% and operating margins of 28-30%.
qualitative.calamity_note: Broken metric: Gate 5 score of 0 due to pro-cyclical share repurchases executed at peak valuations (£38-£40), major distributor overstocking in Latin America & Caribbean, and leadership instability culminating in CEO Debra Crew's July 2025 exit. Moat proof: World #1 spirits franchise (#1 Scotch Johnnie Walker, Guinness booming globally) with unreplicable aged inventory; 5-year median GAAP ROIC remains 14-16% through the downturn. Fix catalyst & kill-switch: 2025 leadership reset enforcing real-time POS sell-out tracking, cost productivity targets, and halting buybacks to prioritize debt reduction to <2.5x net debt/EBITDA; kill switch if ROIC falls below 12% or net leverage exceeds 3.5x for more than two consecutive reporting cycles.
qualitative.note: Qualifies for Calamity Tier (Gate 5 management failure waived as temporary fixable calamity; Anchor Gates 1, 2, 3a, 4 and Gate 6 pass). World #1 spirits leader anchored by irreplaceable aged Scotch stocks and Guinness stout. Multi-cycle ROIC remains resilient at 14-16% despite Latin America destocking shock. Strong balance sheet with interest coverage >6.5x. [5-10Y g: spirits volume 1.5% + premiumisation price 2.0% + Guinness expansion 1.0% - promotional margin drag 0.5% + net debt repayment 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC is ~15.8% (FY20: 16.1%, FY22: 18.4%, FY23: 19.8%, FY24: 15.8%, FY25: 13.7%). Operating margins steady at 28-30%. FCF conversion >85% of net income. Net debt/EBITDA ~2.8x with interest coverage of ~6.8x. Channel inventory in Latin America normalized by late FY25.
